listed_sector_signals.signal: Sappi paper mill discussed as an ISO 50001 case study (pulp & paper), cited from reference [4]
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Sappi Fine Paper Europe is one of Europe’s largest suppliers 
produces reels, specifically designed rotation offset printing.

listed_sector_signals.signal: Paper mill described as a large milling process analogous to the flour mill studied
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Although the product of the plant is paper, and not flour, as in 
the proposed paper, both are large milling processes with several 
analogies.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: CHP with boilers/turbines mentioned in the Sappi paper-mill case study for energy reduction
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
a decision tree 
has been designed to manage the shut down of several boilers or 
turbines in the CHP to reduce energy consumption.

one_line: The paper applies an optimization method to design an energy-metering sensor network for ISO 50001 in a 1.2 MW industrial flour (grain) milling plant; pulp & paper (Sappi mill with CHP) appears only as a cited comparative case study, not the paper's own application context.
